good_thing: (Ozaukee County, Wisconsin): Pine View Wildlife Rehabilitation and Education Center released a 4-month-old badger back into the wild in August. The animal had been found in Dane County in April and was rehabilitated at Pine View, one of the few Wisconsin facilities qualified to care for badgers.
current_or_history: On September 3, 1838, Frederick Douglass began his escape from slavery. Anna Murray helped him disguise himself as a sailor and supplied money for his ticket; he reached New York City in less than 24 hours, traveling by train, ferry, and on foot.
tiny_fact: Bare-nosed wombats make cube-shaped feces. A peer-reviewed study found that the cubes form in the final 17 percent of the intestine, where tissues differ in thickness and stiffness.
thought: Small acts of care still count, even when nobody makes a headline of them.
